title: The elliptical range theorem for the conformal range
summary: The conformal range (or the real Davis--Wielandt shell), which is a particular planar projection of the Davis--Wielandt shell, can be considered as the hyperbolic version of the numerical range; i. e. it is a ``field of values'' which can be interpreted as a subset of the asymptotically closed hyperbolic plane. Here we explain the analogue of the elliptical range theorem of $2\times2$ complex matrices for the conformal range.
